learning_outcomes.text: choose and apply methods to problems in all parts I-IV of the course, as described in the course content
present and justify solutions to tasks within the course content using relevant concepts and clear reasoning

syllabus_topics: Part I: Maclaurin and Taylor expansion
Different forms of the residual term: ordo and Lagrange
Applications include calculation of limit values, investigation of local extreme values ​​and error estimation in approximations
Part II: Ordinary Differential Equations and Integral Equations
First order linear and separable equations
Linear equations of higher order with constant coefficients
Part III: Generalized integrals (G), numerical series (N) and power series (P)
G+N: Convergence investigations and elementary estimates
assessment_rules: Grades for examination modules are decided in accordance with the assessment criteria presented at the start of the course. The grading scale is U, 3, 4, 5.
bibliography: Forsling, Göran, Neymark, Mats, (2011) Matematisk analys : en variabel. 2., [utök. och rev.] uppl. Stockholm : Liber, 2011 ISBN: 9789147100231
Complementary material and a collection of problems edited by the Department of Mathematics.
degree: Industrial Engineering and Management - International (6CIEI), terms 1-6 (first cycle)
